compositionText: Each tablet contains Ibuprofen IP 400 mg and Paracetamol IP 325 mg
summary: A combination painkiller containing an anti-inflammatory medicine and paracetamol.
mechanismSummary: Ibuprofen reduces prostaglandins involved in pain and swelling. Paracetamol adds pain and fever relief.
importantWarnings: Contains paracetamol - do not take other paracetamol products at the same time.|NSAIDs can irritate the stomach lining and cause bleeding in the digestive tract.
cautionGroups: People with stomach ulcers|People with kidney disease|Older adults
storageInformation: Store below 30 C in a dry place.
